title: What is Bai'at?
summary: Bai'at is a covenant: a pledge on something important, taken at the hand of a murshid. Hazrat explains it from the book Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at.

blocks.p: Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. read and explained the small book Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at (the reality of bai'at) by Hazrat Muhammad Abdul Qadeer Siddiqui Hasrat R.A. It opens with the verse of bai'at from Surah al-Fath.

blocks.q: Those who become murids: the Hand of Allah is over their hand. See, this is a very great thing, and yet people do not want to give bai'at.

blocks.p: The book gives the heading 'Bai'at and Iradat' and asks: what is bai'at, and what are its aims? Hazrat reads the answer:

blocks.q: Bai'at is a covenant. It was a custom of the Arabs that when an agreement was made, they struck hand upon hand. In every kingdom an oath of loyalty is taken; in the same way, bai'at is taken to confirm something important.

blocks.h: Bai'at in the time of the Prophet ﷺ

blocks.p: Hazrat reads that in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, a person who became Muslim gave bai'at, and a person who repented gave bai'at. The bai'at of taqwa and tawbah was taken from women too. 'In bai'at there is both,' Hazrat adds, 'taqwa and tawbah.'

Sometimes bai'at was taken to give one's life, as at Hudaybiyyah. Sometimes it was taken on not asking anyone for anything: if a Companion's camel rein fell, he would make the camel kneel and pick it up himself rather than ask someone to hand it to him. And sometimes it was taken to stay steadfast in the love of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ.

blocks.q: In short, taking a pledge on something important is called bai'at.

blocks.p: Hazrat puts it simply: 'What is bai'at? Becoming a murid, that is bai'at.' The bai'at also joins the murid to something very great:

blocks.q: From the 'Arsh, from Allah, a rope hangs down to the earth, and it is in the blessed hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The moment one becomes a murid, a connection with the 'Arsh comes into being.

blocks.p: After the bai'at, Hazrat reads, the shaykh always keeps the murid in his care, and by his gracious attention, his spiritual help and the power of his thought and will, keeps him from bad things and keeps his deeds and intentions sound.

ru.title: Bai'at kya hai?
ru.summary: Bai'at ek ahad hai: kisi aham cheez par ahad lena, murshid ke haath par. Hazrat isko kitaab Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at se samjhaate hain.

blocks.p: Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. ne Hazrat Muhammad Abdul Qadeer Siddiqui Hasrat R.A. ki chhoti si kitaab Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at (bai'at ki haqeeqat) padhi aur samjhaayi. Yeh Surah al-Fath ki bai'at wali aayat se shuru hoti hai.

blocks.q: Jo murid ho rahe hain, unke haath par Allah ka haath hai. Dekhiye, bahut badi baat hai, aur bai'at ko hi nahin karna chahte hain log.

blocks.p: Kitaab 'Bai'at aur Iradat' ka unwaan deti hai aur poochti hai: bai'at kya hai, aur iske aghraaz o maqaasid kya hain? Hazrat jawaab padhte hain:

blocks.q: Bai'at ek mu'ahida hai. Arabon ki ek aadat yeh hai ke koi mu'ahida kiya jaata hai to haath par haath maarte hain. Tamaam saltanaton mein half-e-wafadari liya jaata hai; isi tarah kisi aham baat ki taakeed par bai'at ki jaati hai.

blocks.h: Huzoor ﷺ ke zamaane mein Bai'at

blocks.p: Hazrat padhte hain ke Rasoolullah ﷺ ke zamaane mein jo Musalmaan hota woh bai'at karta, aur jo tauba karta woh bai'at karta. Taqwa aur tauba ki bai'at auraton se bhi li gayi. 'Bai'at mein dono hain,' Hazrat farmate hain, 'taqwa aur tauba.'

Kabhi jaan dene par bai'at li gayi, jaise Hudaybiyyah mein. Kabhi is baat par li gayi ke kisi se kuch nahin maangna: agar kisi Sahabi ke oont ki lagaam gir jaati to woh oont ko bitha kar khud utha lete, lekin kisi se nahin kehte ke utha kar de do. Aur kabhi Allah aur Uske Rasool ﷺ ki mohabbat mein saabit-qadam rehne ke liye li gayi.

blocks.q: Gharz ke kisi aham cheez par ahad lene ka naam bai'at hai.

blocks.p: Hazrat saada alfaaz mein farmate hain: 'Bai'at kya hai? Jo murid hona hai, woh bai'at hai.' Bai'at murid ko ek bahut badi cheez se bhi jod deti hai:

blocks.q: Arsh se, Allah ke paas se, ek rassi zameen tak latakti rehti hai, aur woh Rasoolullah ﷺ ke dast-e-mubarak mein hoti hai. Murid hote hi ta'alluq Arsh se paida ho jaata hai.

blocks.p: Bai'at ke baad, Hazrat padhte hain, shaykh hamesha murid ko apni nigraani mein rakhte hain, aur apni nazar-e-karam, roohani madad aur apne khayal aur iraade ki quwwat se usko buri cheezon se bachaate hain aur uske aamaal aur niyyaton ko durust rakhte hain.
